b1-23-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Café?
b1-23-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks which of two cafés in Budapest you would recommend for the next language exchange. The first one is cheaper than the second.
b1-23-01.prompt: Tell Carlos which café you would choose and why.
cues: Say which café you would choose
b1-23-01.target: Creo que sería mejor elegir el primer café porque es más barato.
b1-23-01.english: I think it would be better to choose the first café because it is cheaper.
b1-23-01.canDo: I can compare options and make a recommendation.

b1-23-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides
b1-23-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you about the two cafés. The first one is cheap, but it is less comfortable.
b1-23-02.prompt: Tell Meg one advantage and one disadvantage of the first café.
b1-23-02.target: Por un lado, el primero es barato; por otro lado, es menos cómodo.
b1-23-02.english: On the one hand, the first one is cheap; on the other hand, it is less comfortable.
b1-23-02.canDo: I can present advantages and disadvantages.

b1-23-03.title: Communicative Challenge: If We Choose the Second
b1-23-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what will happen if you both choose the second café. It is more expensive, but it is quiet.
b1-23-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what the consequences of choosing the second café will be.
b1-23-03.target: Si elegimos el segundo, tendremos que pagar más, pero estaremos más tranquilos.
b1-23-03.english: If we choose the second one, we will have to pay more, but we will be calmer.
b1-23-03.canDo: I can describe consequences of choices.

b1-23-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Is It Worth It?
b1-23-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks whether it is worth paying more for the quiet café. You think it is, and you prefer a calm place.
b1-23-04.prompt: Tell Meg what you think about paying more and what is preferable.
cues: Say whether it is worth it
b1-23-04.target: Creo que merece la pena pagar más. Es preferible elegir un lugar más tranquilo.
b1-23-04.english: I think it is worth paying more. It is preferable to choose a quieter place.

b1-23-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Seminarian and the Widow
b1-23-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read a retelling of the novel Pepita Jiménez by Juan Valera for a class in Budapest. Carlos asks what happens in it.
b1-23-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Luis studies, whom he falls in love with and what he decides.
cues: Say whom he loves and what he decides
b1-23-05.target: Luis de Vargas estudia para ser sacerdote. Se enamora de Pepita, deja el seminario y se casa con ella.
b1-23-05.english: Luis de Vargas studies to be a priest. He falls in love with Pepita, leaves the seminary and marries her.
b1-23-05.canDo: I can reach and justify a decision.

b1-23-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Final Choice
b1-23-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks which café you finally choose and why.
b1-23-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg which café you choose after comparing and give your priority.
cues: Say which you choose and why
b1-23-consolidation.target: Después de comparar los dos cafés, creo que es mejor elegir el segundo porque es más tranquilo.
b1-23-consolidation.english: After comparing the two cafés, I think it is better to choose the second because it is quieter.
